channel.title: Hutch
channel.description: Updates for Hutch — multi-tool macOS utility from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description: • Added Rift and Forge to More from us in Settings.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: • Reaper — a new tool that finds what's eating your Mac's CPU, memory and GPU, then walks you through quitting it one app at a time. Plus live-state highlighting in Toggles and slider-based thresholds.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Caffeinate toggle — keep your Mac awake indefinitely, or for a set duration you dial in; it counts down and releases the assertion automatically. Replaces Keep Awake.
  • Drag to reorder — long-press any toggle in the panel and drag to rearrange it; your order is remembered across launches.
  • Fixed a crash when tapping the +/− steppers on the Caffeinate and Sleep / Shutdown timers.
  • Lighter, more legible search-field text in the Toggles panel.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• ⌘K — actions, anywhere — Press ⌘K on any Pounce result for a keyboard-driven menu of what you can do with it: reveal in Finder, copy its path, quit a running app, and more — all without leaving the launcher.
  • A sharper Toggles popover — It now aims a pointer right at its menu-bar icon, opens with a clean header, and adds a search field up top so you can filter to the switch you want in a single keystroke. Whatever's on is highlighted at a glance.
  • Make results move your way — Choose how Pounce's list animates as you type — Slide, Fade, Pop, or None — in Settings → Pounce. Toggles, Stash, and the launcher all feel livelier and springier too.
  • Panel width, fixed — Compact / Standard / Wide for the Pounce launcher finally resizes it for real.
  • Your clipboard keeps its secrets — Anything a password manager marks as concealed (1Password, Keychain, and friends) is never captured into Pounce's clipboard history.
  • The right result, every keystroke — Pounce's highlight snaps back to the best match as you type, so Return always launches exactly what you meant.
  • A tidier app — Custom-styled dropdowns across Settings, plus we retired the icon-style switch (the 3D glyphs are always on now) and the redundant Tools page.
  • Lighter and steadier — The port killer now lists in the background instead of stalling the launcher, the AI window stops streaming when you close it, and duplicate emoji are gone from the picker.
